_readme: The one registry of public and application facts (plan F7.1, G11). Edit this file, then run `node funding/framework/bin/fund.mjs facts build`. It regenerates FACTS.md, client/public/facts/facts.json, client/lib/facts.generated.ts, backend/src/impact/facts.generated.ts, catnip-heist/src/facts.generated.ts and client/public/shelter-payouts/campaign.json; CI runs `fund facts build --check`. Families: F- facts, P- product claims, C- campaign and config, L- live metrics. Statuses: verified, company-reported, sei-era, live, unverified, retired; unverified and retired entries never have surfaces. Never add secrets, keys, bank details or personal data: the build rejects email, phone and IBAN patterns, and FACTS.md is pasted into AI prompts.

facts.claim: Gifts given through the DonateRouter go only to the shelter wallets the donor signed for, and cannot reach the Token Tails treasury; the router reverts if the payout list changed or any share would reach the treasury
facts.display: Gifts through the router go only to the shelter wallets you signed for: it reverts if that list changes or any share would reach the Token Tails treasury
facts.source: funding/framework/tracks/a-build/shelter-split/src/DonateRouter.sol (recipientsHash bound into the signed nonce, RecipientsChanged, _guard and the post-payout treasury balance check)
facts.note: Planned surface: shelter-payouts. Enforced in code and covered by forge tests (TreasuryShare at 9000 bps, inactive shelter, unallocated bps, rounding dust, paused split, a lying split caught by the post-payout check; RecipientsChanged when a shelter is re-pointed or re-weighted between signing and submit, on the signed and native paths) and by router/simulate-arc-testnet.sh on the live Arc testnet split; no router is deployed yet. CUSTODY GATE: the only registered shelter wallet is held by Token Tails until handover, so router gifts would land in a wallet Token Tails controls. This fact may be set verified only once campaign.shelter.handover is done (as for P-003), and until then any display of it must add: the shelter wallet is held by Token Tails until handover. Keep NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_DONATE off until handover. After handover and a founder deploy: add the entry to tracks/a-build/router-deployments.json, set status verified with that entry as the source, set asOf and maxAgeDays, and add the shelter-payouts surface. Limits, disclosed in the README: the unchecked donateNative(memo) and flush pay whatever list is current; the split owner can still change the list for gifts signed after the change (a public event on the split).

campaign.name: Pink Paw rescue fund
campaign.rotation: At handover: set this wallet's toBlock to the last block before the switch, append Pink Paw's own wallet (holder "shelter", fromBlock = toBlock + 1), point shelter.wallet at it, set handover to "handed-over", run `fund facts build` and deploy the client and the backend. A sweep from the held wallet to the new one is not counted twice: transfers between campaign wallets are skipped.

facts.note: Founder, 2026-10-04: 'goal: 50000 USDC for Pink Paw' (was 90 USDC by 31 Jan 2027, reachable on the 1 USDC/day treat budget alone). Progress (review fix, 2026-10-04) is the USDC that CAME IN, not a balance: the backend (GET /shelter/goal/C-001) sums the Transfer logs to the campaign wallets (campaign.wallets, each counted only inside its fromBlock..toBlock range) and skips transfers whose sender is another campaign wallet, so a handover sweep counts once and spending never lowers the bar. It reads Arc's system Transfer log (inflowLog: 0xffff...fffe, 18 decimals), which Arc emits for every USDC move, native or through the ERC-20 view at 0x3600... (read-only check on rpc.mainnet.arc.io, 2026-10-04: a native send emits only that log; an ERC-20 transfer emits it and the 0x3600 log). The public RPC refuses eth_getLogs ranges of 10,000 blocks or more, so the backend scans 9,999-block windows and keeps a cursor in MongoDB. fromBlock 23790973 is the first block of 2026-10-02 UTC; the wallet's balance was 0 at block 23790972 and it had sent no transaction (nonce 0). The pages fall back to the balance (minus startBalance) only while there is one wallet and it has never sent a transaction, when the balance's growth is exactly what came in. What can arrive today: Token Tails holds 0xE299... for Pink Paw, and the custody rules keep public gifts, the match and x402 payments away from a Token-Tails-held wallet, so today only sponsored treats reach it (and the shelter's share of cat purchases, only while CRYPTO_PAY_SHELTER_SHARE_ENABLED is on and a checkout settles through the split). The pages list only the sources the backend reports live. Gifts, the match and x402 count once Pink Paw holds its own wallet (campaign.rotation). End date: 30 Sep 2027, one year from launch: public giving waits for the handover (planned before 5 Dec 2026). Caps: goal.tokenTails is computed from the CODE DEFAULTS (DEFAULT_DAILY_BUDGET_WEI, DEFAULT_MATCH_DAILY, DEFAULT_MATCH_POOL in shelter-onchain.config.ts), not the production environment, which this registry cannot read; if production raises the treat budget or the match pool, the 'Token Tails adds at most' figure is wrong until these entries are updated. goal.donorDependent is true and no copy may call the goal reachable. Staleness: maxAgeDays 125 makes this entry stale around 6 Feb 2027, long before the 30 Sep 2027 end; that is the review cadence (re-check the wallets, caps and dates), not an error. Generated into client/public/shelter-payouts/campaign.json (publishing it is a client deploy).
